visibility.updates: existing active project check-ins and material milestones

lanes.result: The detached right collar edit cleared the original crossing but created three nearby overlaps and left a fold. Independent review rejected it. The tested pose also still misses left heel contact.
lanes.next: No collar-only boundary met the tested load and protection requirements. Keep this approach retired and evaluate a different animation-ready base or separately authorized design.

lanes.result: The detached repeat-pine test awarded one wood. The old save scripts refused to read or overwrite the newer save. Separate carry visuals and an authored second row remain unverified.
lanes.next: Keep the repeat-pine candidate detached until a save compatibility plan is approved. Separately verify real carry mounts before adding transfer effects.

lanes.result: 360 isolated baseline checks passed. Three starter logs each count, but the stock view shows just one shared carry bundle. Furnace purchase and save recovery work without an arrival effect.
lanes.next: Bind each carried log to a distinct visible slot, then verify real arrivals before attempting the optional pad animation.

lanes.result: 47 Level 1 scenarios scoped. The isolated Godot audio player passed 131 checks across four modes without exit leaks. This verifies player behavior, not audible playback or installed game audio.
lanes.next: Stage a clearly opt-in listening preview; verify audible playback and device mix before any integration.

lanes.result: The isolated native test reached both standing positions. The independent review reproduced obstruction on all 16 straight hand-to-marker paths tested. This does not rule out an authored reach animation.
lanes.next: Compare a separately staged approach or reachable handling target before any serving integration. Customer and payment behavior remain out of this test.

lanes.result: Enemy animals are in scope, fish are not. No approved runtime species, encounter or reward tied to this build.
lanes.next: Lock the authored Level 1 enemy asset and real encounter authority before adding combat or related sound.

role_activity.title: Prepared Bot Office feed data
role_activity.summary: Mapped project lanes to their roster roles and verified the data with the deployed dashboard’s parser. This is reported work, not live worker monitoring.
role_activity.next: Keep role reports tied to verified results.

role_activity.title: Right boot collar trial rejected
role_activity.summary: The original clash cleared, but the edit created nearby overlaps and a fold remained.
role_activity.next: Do not promote; a different bounded design needs evidence under load.

role_activity.title: Independently reproduced collar trial regressions
role_activity.summary: Two crossings were removed and three were introduced around the edited patch. The sole geometry stayed unchanged.
role_activity.next: Review an exact new candidate when permitted and frozen; no gait approval.

role_activity.title: Verified the three starter wood sources
role_activity.summary: An isolated native test verified two loose pickups and the settled pine as three distinct committed sources. This is not a pass for individual carry visuals or the purchase sweep.
role_activity.next: Verify individual larger mounts and deliveries to the purchase deck.

role_activity.title: Passed isolated playback-state and shutdown checks
role_activity.summary: All 131 checks passed. This verifies the player’s behavior, not sound on a phone or audio in the playable build.
role_activity.next: Run the opt-in listening preview on an authorized output-capable device.

role_activity.title: Verified disposable repeat-pine save behavior
role_activity.summary: Sixty native checks passed. The older save code preserved the newer save by refusing to read or overwrite it; this is not backward compatibility.
role_activity.next: Hold durable adoption; continue tests only on disposable profiles.

role_activity.title: Counter reach test rejected the original handling paths
role_activity.summary: Both sides are walkable. The original counter geometry obstructs the measured hand paths from both stances.
role_activity.next: Verify an alternate staged reach design before integration.

office_events.message: Handoff summary: The independently reproduced overlaps span the boots, knees, and hems. The current pose stays rejected; one same-look detached rebuild is the next test.
Handoff summary: The three original starter pickups were verified as separate committed sources. The current grouped carry display stayed unchanged; it cannot trigger the purchase sweep.
Handoff summary: The first detached garment rebuild failed with six overlaps at rest. Keep it out of the game and verify any revised garment at rest before testing gait.
Handoff summary: The stock bundle cannot show three individual arrivals. Keep purchase logic independent and test real per-log carry slots before adding the deck effect.
Handoff summary: The six seam changes are clear at rest. Keep the patch detached; small probe displacements exposed folds and no actual gait has passed.
Handoff summary: Both counter stances are reachable, but the tested straight hand paths are blocked. Do not treat the current markers as usable for serving.
Handoff summary: The original collar crossing cleared, but new neighboring overlaps and a remaining fold prevent approval. Keep the playable character unchanged.
Handoff summary: The first eligible repeat cut earned one wood. Older save code safely refused the newer payload; keep the change detached pending a compatibility plan.
